scripts.build:cap: sh -c 'mkdir -p .cap_bak && mv src/app/api .cap_bak/ 2>/dev/null; mv src/app/closet/\[id\] .cap_bak/_closet_id 2>/dev/null; mv src/app/photo/\[slug\] .cap_bak/_photo_slug 2>/dev/null; BUILD_TARGET=capacitor next build; EXIT=$?; mv .cap_bak/_closet_id src/app/closet/\[id\] 2>/dev/null; mv .cap_bak/_photo_slug src/app/photo/\[slug\] 2>/dev/null; mv .cap_bak/api src/app/ 2>/dev/null; rmdir .cap_bak 2>/dev/null; exit $EXIT'
